content.text:
Run the "deep-research" workflow.

Deep research harness — fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify claims, synthesize a cited report.

When the user wants a deep, multi-source, fact-checked research report on any topic. BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.

Phases:
- Scope: Decompose question (from args) into 5 search angles
- Search: 5 parallel WebSearch agents, one per angle
- Fetch: URL-dedup, fetch top 15 sources, extract falsifiable claims
- Verify: 3-vote adversarial verification per claim (need 2/3 refutes to kill)
- Synthesize: Merge semantic dupes, rank by confidence, cite sources

Invoke: Workflow({ name: "deep-research" })

Carlos,

You have Mesa Vista 4C down as wrapped from its June turn and ready to release, and Brooke is set to list it on your word. I ran my own QC pass before sign-off, and I'm holding it — it is not marketing-ready. Copying Brooke so she holds marketing until I clear it.

The turn in question is the June turn: move-out 6/15, target-ready 6/30 (both dates have passed). The Airtable Make-Ready record for that turn is still In Progress, with the two carrying scopes — the deep clean and the interior repaint — noted as "still tracking." Here's what my pass found, scope by scope:

1) Deep clean (Sunshine Cleaning) — NOT closed.
   Vendor bill #2026-SC-4C for $387 is entered in QuickBooks but unpaid: the full $387 balance is outstanding, due 5/31 and now past due. A billed-but-unpaid scope doesn't count as closed.

2) Interior repaint (Pete Donovan / Permian Make-Ready Crew) — NOT closed.
   Vendor bill #PD-2026-09 for $1,340 is entered but unpaid: the full $1,340 balance is outstanding, due 5/31 and now past due. It's also miscoded to Management Fee Income and should be corrected.

3) No QC sign-off exists for this turn.
   The MR-4C-2026-08 record stating "QC walkthrough by Jaime ... passed re-inspection" is dated 5/1 — it predates the 6/15 move-out and I did not perform it. It can't certify this turn. (The separate Ready record dated move-out 6/1 / target 6/14 is an earlier turn, not this one.)

4) The re-inspection isn't on the calendar.
   The mid-July re-inspection this release is supposed to hinge on isn't scheduled. It needs to be booked, and my sign-off is contingent on it passing.

5) Owner billing is ahead of the work.
   Linda Castillo was already sent a "fully wrapped up / market-ready" cost summary and billed via owner invoice 2026-537, while both vendor bills are still unpaid and the turn is open. That needs to be reconciled.

To clear the hold: both vendor bills paid; deep clean and repaint QC-verified against the 6/15 turn; the re-inspection scheduled and passed; and the owner billing reconciled. Once those are done I'll re-walk it, and if it passes I'll move it to Ready and hand it to Brooke for listing — not before.

I've logged the full determination on the make-ready record and opened OPS-1000 with the specifics and exit criteria. Let me know once the bills are cleared and the re-inspection is on the calendar and I'll get out there.

Thanks,
Jaime
